matrices.description: 2×2 matrices crossing two paradigm dimensions. Each matrix defines 4 quadrants with typologies.

dimension_a.description: First dimension being crossed (e.g. 'Temporal variation', 'Risk level').

quadrants.description: Four quadrants of the 2×2 grid. Each has a descriptive label and the properties that fall into it.

label.description: Descriptive label for this quadrant (e.g. 'High Risk / Rapid Response').

properties.description: Properties from the simplified tables that fall into this quadrant.

family_correlations.description: Which of the 12 Glaserian theoretical families apply to this memo, with relevance scores.

family.description: Name of the Glaserian theoretical family.

family_label.description: Human-readable label for the family (e.g. 'Proceso / Secuencia', 'Causal / Cadena').

relevance.description: How strongly this family lens applies to the memo. 0.0 = not applicable, 1.0 = strongly applicable.

rationale.description: Why this family applies: what patterns in the memo does this lens reveal?

homeless_insights.description: Ideas from the memo that do not correlate with any other saturated category. Possible new emergent codes or dimensions.

items.description: A homeless insight: idea that stands alone, not linking to other categories.

agent_1_proposed.description: Summary of what the memo_generator proposed (key findings from the narrative memo).

agent_2_challenged.description: What the memo_simplifier simplified, removed, or flagged as a tension.

agent_3_found.description: What cross-memo patterns this correlator discovered using the 12 families.

consensus.description: Points on which all 3 agents agree.

disagreements.description: Points on which the agents differ and why.
